entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Ah, if it isn’t [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! If only you’d
been
here
a few
minutes
earlier![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_01

entries.text: Hey, did those lousy three Pokémon come here?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_01

entries.text: I believe you mean the LOYAL Three, Carmine.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_02

entries.text: Forget about that silly title![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_02

entries.text: Always with your attitude...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_03

entries.text: But yes, you did miss out on an incredible treat!\c\nThe Loyal Three were just visiting our humble\nlittle hall![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_04

entries.text: It seemed they wished to collect the shining\nmasks we’ve kept safe here at Kitakami Hall...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_05

entries.text: so naturally we representatives of the hall were\nhappy to return the masks to them with all haste![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_06

entries.text: You gave them the masks?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_03

entries.text: And we offered them a platter of our special\nKitakami Mochi, packed full of our best herbs!\r\nThe Loyal Three gobbled them up in a flash![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_07

entries.text: And you FED them?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_04

entries.text: Kitakami Mochi are full of nutrition! The Loyal\nThree are bigger and stronger now, I’m sure!
entries.label: sdc01_0350_person_01

entries.text: But those lousy three are the bad guys! The masks\nbelong to Ogerpon!\c\nUgh, I really wish I could tell them everything...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_05

entries.text: So, where did those three go?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_06

entries.text: They went at once to ascend Oni Mountain![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_08

entries.text: Perhaps they have it in mind to finish off the\nterrible ogre that lurks in the Dreaded Den.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_09

entries.text: No wonder they were dubbed the Loyal Three!\nSuch hardworking heroes they are! Hahaha!
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_10

entries.text: This isn’t the time to be laughing at all![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_07

entries.text: If the story we heard is true, then those three\nmust’ve gone to get revenge on Ogerpon.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_08

entries.text: They say the ogre fought using the powers of its\nmasks.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_09

entries.text: But Ogerpon doesn’t have any masks right now,\nright?! It won’t stand a chance![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_10

entries.text: We should help it!
entries.label: sdc01_0350_select_01

entries.text: Let’s return its mask!
entries.label: sdc01_0350_select_02

entries.text: Yeah, we’re on the same page! But we should\nsplit up![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_11

entries.text: You head to the Dreaded Den and help\nOgerpon![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_12

entries.text: I’ll go back home to get the mask fixed up! Give\nme the mask and the crystal![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_13

entries.text: You gave Carmine the Teal Mask and the Crystal\nCluster.
entries.label: sdc01_0350_system_01

entries.text: Thanks![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_14

entries.text: I’ll head your way the moment the mask’s fixed!\nUntil then, make sure Ogerpon’s safe![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_sister_15

entries.text: The Loyal Three were headed up Oni Mountain\nwhen we last saw them.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0350_caretaker_11
